nodes.description: transfer(address,uint) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
ensure(address,address,uint) internal view; whitelist gate using owner, UNI, pairFor-derived pair, tradeAddress and canSale, otherwise defers to condition()
transferFrom(address,address,uint) public payable; checks allowance of msg.sender, calls ensure(), then performs unchecked balance/allowance updates and _onSaleNum increment
approve(address,uint) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without zero-allowance safeguard
condition(address,uint) internal view; enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale and _onSaleNum[_from] limits
delegate(address,bytes) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address and calldata
init(uint,uint,uint) public; owner-only setter of _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum (operation state)
batchSend(address[],uint) public payable; owner-only loop with unchecked balance arithmetic and duplicate Transfer events
setTradeAddress(address) public; owner-only writer of tradeAddress whitelist slot
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure; derives Uniswap pair address via keccak256 of factory, sorted tokens and init code hash
LionSpaceInu constructor(string,string,uint) payable; mints totalSupply to msg.sender, sets owner and unlimited UNI allowance
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary code in this contract's storage context under owner authority
balanceOf[_from] -= _value; balanceOf[_to] += _value; raw unchecked arithmetic (no SafeMath in LionSpaceInu)
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; raw unchecked subtraction after a >= check
uint total = _value * _tos.length; balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total; balanceOf[_to] += _value; unchecked multiplication/addition
msg.sender; untrusted external caller used for owner checks, allowance keys, mint target and _from identity
address private owner; privileged role controlling init, batchSend, setTradeAddress, delegate
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances mutated by transferFrom/batchSend
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spend approvals written by approve/transferFrom
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-sender sale participation counter incremented in transferFrom
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; per-address whitelist that bypasses condition()
uint256 private _minSale; minimum sell amount gate read by condition() and set by init()
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum sell amount gate read by condition() and set by init()
uint256 private _saleNum; max number of sell participations per address, set by init()
address tradeAddress; mutable whitelist slot bypassing the sale gate, set by setTradeAddress
uint public totalSupply; fixed at construction time
string public name; token name set in constructor
string public symbol; token symbol set in constructor
uint constant public decimals = 18; scaling factor used in constructor and init
address constant UNI = 0x7a25...488D; hardcoded Uniswap router whitelisted and pre-approved for uint(-1)
_to recipient of transfer()
_value amount of transfer()
_from source address of transferFrom()
_to recipient address of transferFrom()
_value amount checked against allowance/balance of transferFrom()
_from address whitelist-tested in ensure()
_to address whitelist-tested in ensure()
_value forwarded to condition() from ensure()
_from address whose _onSaleNum is limited in condition()
_value amount range-checked by _minSale/_maxSale in condition()
a target address of the owner-controlled delegatecall
b calldata payload of the delegatecall
saleNum assigned to _saleNum by init()
token scaled by 10**decimals into _minSale by init()
maxToken scaled by 10**decimals into _maxSale by init()
_tos array of recipients iterated by batchSend()
_value per-recipient amount used in batchSend()
total = _value * _tos.length; unchecked aggregate debit in batchSend()
loop index i over _tos in batchSend()
_to = _tos[i] per-iteration recipient in batchSend()
addr written into tradeAddress whitelist by setTradeAddress()
factory address folded into the pair address hash
tokenA sorted against tokenB in pairFor()
tokenB sorted against tokenA in pairFor()
pair computed address returned by pairFor()
token0 lower-ordered token in pairFor()
token1 higher-ordered token in pairFor()
_name stored into name by the constructor
_symbol stored into symbol by the constructor
_supply scaled by 10**decimals into totalSupply and minted to msg.sender

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as _from when transfer forwards to transferFrom
transfer() delegates its whole effect to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
untrusted msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whether to spend allowance and is used as the allowance mapping key
transferFrom requires ensure() before moving balances; ensure() is the whitelist/sale permission gate
ensure() falls back to condition() when the caller is not in the owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale whitelist
whitelist bypass compares _from and _to against owner, so owner membership grants unrestricted transfers
canSale[_from] is a per-address flag that bypasses the sale restriction enforced by condition()
tradeAddress is a mutable whitelist slot read by ensure()
ensure() calls pairFor() to compute the canonical Uniswap pair address for address(this)
ensure() also whitelists the hardcoded UNI router constant
transferFrom performs raw balanceOf subtraction/addition on _from and _to without SafeMath
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with raw integer arithmetic
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after every transfer
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum
condition() enforces the _minSale lower bound on _value
condition() enforces the _maxSale upper bound on _value
condition() reads _saleNum as the allowed participation count
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before performing a delegatecall, so owner identity is the only guard on arbitrary code execution
delegate() passes owner-supplied address and calldata into an arbitrary delegatecall

the delegatecall executes untrusted code in this contract's storage context and can re-enter transferFrom/approve or rewrite balanceOf, allowance and owner state while the outer call is still in flight
init() writes _saleNum from the saleNum argument
init() writes _minSale as token*(10**decimals)
init() writes _maxSale as maxToken*(10**decimals)
init() gates state mutation on msg.sender == owner
batchSend() gates distribution on msg.sender == owner

batchSend() reads and writes balanceOf for the owner and each recipient

setTradeAddress() assigns the addr argument to tradeAddress

approve() overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-allowance precondition

constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the initial totalSupply

constructor assigns the token symbol
constructor uses the constant decimals for supply scaling
constructor references the hardcoded UNI router constant for the unlimited allowance
